summary: The 1961 British Grand Prix was notable for being the only race that year featuring a front-engined car, while all other teams had transitioned to mid-engined cars.

key_statements.statement: The 1961 British Grand Prix was a round of the 1961 season.
In 1961, all teams had switched to mid-engined cars.
The only front-engined car to compete that year was at the 1961 British Grand Prix.
